subject.title: docs: document optional workspace capability inventory records

question: Should OpenClaw core documentation endorse `capabilities/*.md` as an optional workspace-local inventory convention, separate from `TOOLS.md`, workspace skills, plugins, and ClawHub?
rationale: The patch is technically focused, but choosing a new durable workspace convention is a product and documentation-boundary decision that source checks cannot resolve.

options.title: Adopt the advanced inventory convention
options.body: Merge the docs-only convention while retaining its explicit non-runtime, non-authoritative boundaries.

options.title: Retain existing documentation surfaces
options.body: Decline the new directory convention and direct workspace-local discovery guidance through `TOOLS.md`, skills, plugins, and ClawHub.

recommendation.title: Adopt the advanced inventory convention
recommendation.body: Merge the docs-only convention while retaining its explicit non-runtime, non-authoritative boundaries.

likelyOwner.reason: Current history ties steipete to the capability-surface documentation and VISION-level boundary that this proposal would extend.
